name: Program Analysis
description: Static/dynamic analysis, symbolic execution, taint tracking, and bug detection for security.
narrative:
The earliest papers in this collection focus on tracking how sensitive data moves through complex software. "Sensitive Information Tracking in Commodity IoT" (2018) applied taint tracking to the messy world of IoT apps, while "Enabling Refinable Cross-Host Attack Investigation with Efficient Data Flow Tagging and Tracking" (2018) pushed data-flow analysis across machine boundaries for forensics. Alongside these, the field was already getting self-critical: "Discovering Flaws in Security-Focused Static Analysis Tools for Android using Systematic Mutation" (2018) showed that the analysis tools themselves were buggy and could be fooled by simple code mutations.

Around 2019-2020 the area broadened and got more sophisticated. Researchers began fusing classic techniques with machine learning, as in "DEEPVSA: Facilitating Value-set Analysis with Deep Learning for Postmortem Program Analysis" (2019), and sharpened abstract interpretation for concrete security goals like "Identifying Cache-Based Side Channels through Secret-Augmented Abstract Interpretation" (2019). Fuzzing surged into the spotlight: "GREYONE: Data Flow Sensitive Fuzzing" (2020) tied taint analysis directly into the fuzzing loop, and "MUZZ: Thread-aware Grey-box Fuzzing for Effective Bug Hunting in Multithreaded Programs" (2020) tackled concurrency. At the same time, analyzing inaccessible code became a major theme through firmware re-hosting in "HALucinator: Firmware Re-hosting Through Abstraction Layer Emulation" (2020) and emulation of trusted code in "PARTEMU" (2020), while "AURORA: Statistical Crash Analysis for Automated Root Cause Explanation" (2020) moved beyond finding crashes to explaining them.

From 2021 onward the techniques specialized into new domains. Symbolic execution and model checking were aimed at blockchain in "ETHBMC: A Bounded Model Checker for Smart Contracts" (2020) and "SmarTest" (2021), the latter even using a language model to guide the search. Taint and data-flow work kept maturing toward efficiency and generality, from "SelectiveTaint: Efficient Data Flow Tracking With Static Binary Rewriting" (2021) to cross-language tracking in "PolyCruise: A Cross-Language Dynamic Information Flow Analysis" (2022). The community also began rigorously evaluating its own tools, with "FIXREVERTER: A Realistic Bug Injection Methodology for Benchmarking Fuzz Testing" (2022) providing honest benchmarks.

The most recent papers show the field tackling harder targets and entire ecosystems. Fuzzing now reaches deep into hardware with "Cascade: CPU Fuzzing via Intricate Program Generation" (2024) and into complex web stacks with "Atropos: Effective Fuzzing of Web Applications for Server-Side Vulnerabilities" (2024), while supply-chain security drove behavior-based detection in "DONAPI: Malicious NPM Packages Detector using Behavior Sequence Knowledge Mapping" (2024). Overall the area has evolved from tainting and tracking data, through ML-augmented and fuzzing-centric bug hunting, to domain-specialized analysis of firmware, smart contracts, CPUs, and software supply chains.

milestones.title: Sensitive Information Tracking in Commodity IoT
milestones.note: brought taint tracking to the emerging IoT app ecosystem, defining an early target for the area

milestones.title: Discovering Flaws in Security-Focused Static Analysis Tools for Android using Systematic Mutation
milestones.note: turned analysis inward, showing security static-analysis tools were themselves unreliable and could be evaded

milestones.title: GREYONE: Data Flow Sensitive Fuzzing
milestones.note: integrated data-flow/taint analysis into the fuzzing loop, a turning point toward analysis-guided bug hunting

milestones.title: HALucinator: Firmware Re-hosting Through Abstraction Layer Emulation
milestones.note: made dynamic analysis of otherwise inaccessible embedded firmware practical via abstraction-layer emulation

milestones.title: SmarTest: Effectively Hunting Vulnerable Transaction Sequences in Smart Contracts through Language Model-Guided Symbolic Execution
milestones.note: applied symbolic execution to smart contracts and used a language model to guide the search, signaling the domain-specialization and ML-guidance shift

milestones.title: PolyCruise: A Cross-Language Dynamic Information Flow Analysis
milestones.note: extended information-flow analysis across multiple languages, matching how real multi-language software is built

milestones.title: FIXREVERTER: A Realistic Bug Injection Methodology for Benchmarking Fuzz Testing
milestones.note: gave the fuzzing community realistic, reproducible benchmarks to honestly evaluate competing techniques

milestones.title: Cascade: CPU Fuzzing via Intricate Program Generation
milestones.note: pushed fuzzing down to the hardware level by generating intricate programs to stress CPU internals
